_comment: Monsterball M1-M3 unattended overnight soak (0.9.8-dev c88a9985, the slam + vauss finisher build). frenzy.mn3, 4v4 (soak-bots-8.cfg), 20-min rounds, 6 rounds ~= 2h. Same cfg as the interactive smoke (soak-dedicated-mball.cfg) so the numbers are directly comparable to a POV session. Goal: collect enough goals to read finisher conversion (good goals vs blunders/own-goals) AND role stability WITHOUT a human present. Judge with analyze_bot_log.py '## Monsterball': goals/round is the outcome metric; MBALL_ZERO_GOALS = finisher not converting (slam alignment gate too strict or never arms); MBALL_OWN_GOAL_EXCESS = own-goal regression (blunder gate failure or keeper-bounce chaos); MBALL_ROLE_THRASH = roles swapping near the 10s commitment cadence. The 'field' role (index 0) is the overflow bot beyond the 3 stations on >3-bot teams — expected on 4v4, not a bug. Compare frenzy (single-room goal?) vs mayhem later if frenzy converts cleanly — operator-approved alternates: MAYHEM.MN3.
